While inlining `GeneratedImageSchema` and related types makes this seam more self-contained, it introduces code duplication from `contracts/image-generation.contract.ts`. If this schema is stable, this is acceptable. However, if it's expected to change, you might consider moving it to a shared location (like `contracts/shared.contract.ts`) to avoid future maintenance issues where the two definitions could drift apart.

These migrated seam artifacts now live under `src/lib/seams/...`, but the proof-freshness gates still only watch the old flat-layout locations (`contracts`, `fixtures`, `src/lib/mocks`, `tests/contract`, `src/lib/adapters`). Future changes to these new contract/mock/test files can therefore leave stale `verify.txt`/cipher evidence passing unless the watch paths are updated to include `src/lib/seams`.

The registry now points this previously probed browser seam at `src/lib/seams/auth-context-seam/probe.ts`, but that new file is only a no-op `export {}` stub. Running the registered probe no longer exercises the seam or refreshes evidence/fixtures, so the retained last-probe date overstates the current probe coverage.

This issue also appears on line 30 of the same file.

This entry points ChatInterpretationSeam at a new `probe.ts` that only exports an empty module, replacing the previous runnable chat-interpretation probe. That means the documented probe path no longer captures provider/contract behavior despite the existing last-probe metadata.

This issue also appears in the following locations of the same file:
- line 38
- line 40
